WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic,
        AVG(HGB) / AVG(HCT) AS hgb_hct_ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
all_patient_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(hgb_hct_ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM patient_averages
)
SELECT
    AVG(p.avg_pic) AS avg_of_avg_pic,
    AVG(p.hgb_hct_ratio) AS avg_hgb_hct_ratio,
    AVG(p.hgb_hct_ratio - a.avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_ratio
FROM patient_averages p
CROSS JOIN all_patient_average a
WHERE p.hgb_hct_ratio > a.avg_ratio
